Content: The year is split into 24 solar terms, one every 15 degrees of the sun's path. This is astronomy, and Saju uses it to set month pillars.
Label: Astronomical fact

Content: In Saju a new month starts at a solar term, not on the 1st of the calendar month or at the new moon. Getting this time right matters for the month pillar.
Source: 24 Solar Terms in Bazi; Four Pillars of Destiny - Wikipedia
Label: Calculation rule

Content: The Saju year begins at Ipchun (start of spring, around February 4), not at Lunar New Year. Births within a day of Ipchun need an exact time check.
Label: Calculation rule
